question: Which political party was founded by Kanshi Ram?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bahujan Samaj Party**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kanshi Ram was the founder of the Bahujan Samaj Party(BSP)__ political party.
 
• BSP was founded in 1984.
 
• It is symbolic to the 'Majority of People' and represents the oppressed sections of the society such as the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Classes as well as religious minorities.
 
• In 1993, Kanshi Ram was succeeded by Mayawati as President of the BSP.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Samajwadi Party:**

 
 
• The Samajwadi Party was founded by **Mulayam Singh Yadav** in 1992.
 
• It is a socialist party that has a strong base in Uttar Pradesh and is known for its advocacy for the rights of the lower castes and minorities.
 
 
 
• **Janata Dal (United):**
 
 
• The Janata Dal (United) was formed in 2003 by the merger of the Janata Dal and Lok Shakti Party.
 
• Its founder is **Nitish Kumar**, who has been the Chief Minister of Bihar multiple times.
 
• It is a regional party with a significant presence in Bihar and is known for its emphasis on development and good governance.
